Field.name: Origin
Field.usage: Change the origin in X, Y, Z
Field.manpage: (Interactive ORG) Change the origin in X, Y, Z. In IMOD, the origin is defined as the coordinates of the origin relative to the lower-left corner of the first section in the file, in units scaled by the pixel size. The origin is defined in the opposite way in UCSF Chimera; use INVERTORG/-invertorg to switch the sign of the origin values.

Field.name: CellSize
Field.usage: Change the cell size in X, Y, Z
Field.manpage: (Interactive CEL) Change the cell size in X, Y, Z. This will show up as a change in pixel spacing, as described above.

Field.name: PixelSize
Field.usage: Change the pixel size in X, Y, Z to given values
Field.manpage: (Interactive DEL) Change the pixel size in X, Y, Z to given values. The program will change the cell size so that the ratio of cell to sample size will give the entered pixel size.

Field.name: MapIndexes
Field.usage: Set mapping from X, Y, Z to rows, columns, sections
Field.manpage: (Interactive MAP) Set mapping from X, Y, Z to rows, columns, sections. The only effect of this in IMOD is to reorder the sample grid and pixel spacing values by the given mapping. Do not use it.

Field.name: SampleSize
Field.usage: Set sampling in X, Y, Z
Field.manpage: (Interactive SAM) Set sampling in X, Y, Z. See note above on IMOD conventions.

Field.name: TiltCurrent
Field.usage: Change current tilt angles to given alpha, beta, gamma
Field.manpage: (Interactive TLT) Change current tilt angles to given alpha, beta, gamma. These values will be used to apply a rotation to a model loaded into 3dmod along with the image.

Field.name: TiltOriginal
Field.usage: Change original tilt angles
Field.manpage: (Interactive TLT_ORIG) Change original tilt angles. These angles have no effect in IMOD.

Field.name: RotateTilt
Field.usage: Rotate current tilt angles by the given alpha, beta, and gamma.
Field.manpage: (Interactive TLT_ROT) Rotate current tilt angles by the given alpha, beta, and gamma values, where the rotations are applied the order gamma (around Z), beta (around Y), alpha (around X).

Field.name: MinMaxMean
Field.usage: Recompute the minimum, maximum, and mean and the RMS density
Field.manpage: (Interactive MMM) Read the file to recompute the minimum, maximum, and mean densities and the RMS density.

Field.name: RootMeanSquare
Field.usage: Print current RMS value then do same operation as -mmm
Field.manpage: (Interactive RMS) Print the current RMS value (root-mean-square deviation from the mean density) then do the same operation as MMM/-mmm.

Field.name: FixPixel
Field.usage: Set the cell and sample sizes the same as the image size
Field.manpage: (Interactive FIXPIXEL) Set the cell and sample sizes the same as the image size, resulting in a pixel spacing of 1, 1, 1.

Field.name: FixGrid
Field.usage: Set the sample size the same as the image size and preserve pixel size
Field.manpage: (Interactive FIXGRID) Set the sample size the same as the image size and modify the cell size so as to preserve the pixel size.

Field.name: FeiPixel
Field.usage: Set the pixel spacing in X, Y, Z from the extended header
Field.manpage: (Interactive FEIPIXEL) Set the pixel spacing in X, Y, Z from the value for the pixel size of the first section in an Agard/FEI-style extended header. If the existing pixel spacing is not 1 but is equal to 2, 3, or 4, this will be assumed to represent a binning of the data, and the pixel size will be multiplied by this value. However, if the pixel size has already been transferred or the pixel spacing does not correspond to a small integer, the program will transfer the pixel size only if a positive number is entered for this option. It will exit if 0 or a negative nunber is entered for this option when running with command-line arguments, or if -1 is entered when running interactively.

Field.name: FixExtra
Field.usage: Change header flags to avoid misinterpreting as a montage
Field.manpage: (Interactive FIXEXTRA) Change the flags in the header so that 3dmod no longer interprets the extended header as having piece coordinates for a montage.

Field.name: FixMode
Field.usage: Change mode from 1 (signed 16-bit integer) to 6 (unsigned) or from 6 to 1
Field.manpage: (Interactive FIXMODE) Change mode from 1 (signed 16-bit integer) to 6 (unsigned) or from 6 to 1. The program will warn if the current minimum and maximum densities indicate that there are values that will not be interpreted correctly after the change.

Field.name: InvertOrigin
Field.usage: Invert the signs of the X, Y, and Z origin values
Field.manpage: (Interactive INVERTORG) Invert the signs of the X, Y, and Z origin values to switch the header between different definitions of the origin. This operation will not change the flag about the origin inversion and will invert the origin values seen inside IMOD programs as well as those stored in the header.

Field.name: ToggleOrigin
Field.usage: Invert the sign of the origin in the file by changing a header flag
Field.manpage: (Interactive INVERTORG) Invert the signs of the X, Y, and Z origin values stored in the file header without changing the values seen inside IMOD programs. This will be done by setting the flag that determines whether values are inverted on output to the file or not.

Field.name: SetMinMaxMean
Field.usage: Set the minimum, maximum, and mean densities directly with the given values
Field.manpage: (Interactive SETMMM) Set the minimum, maximum, and mean densities directly with the given values.

Field.name: RealMode
Field.usage: Change a mode 4 FFT file to mode 2 and double the X size
Field.manpage: (Interactive REAL) Change a mode 4 FFT file to mode 2 and double the X size.

Field.name: ComplexMode
Field.usage: Change a mode 2 file to mode 4 and divide the X size by 2; this can be done only if the X size is two times an odd number
Field.manpage: (Interactive FFT) Change a mode 2 file to mode 4 and divide the X size by 2; this can be done only if the X size is two times an odd number.

Field.name: Change4BitMode
Field.usage: Change mode for 4-bit data to 101 (1) or from 101 (-1)
Field.manpage: (Interactive 4BIT) For a positive entry, change a mode 0 file to the 4-bit mode 101 and double the size in X that is stored in the header. The header listing will look the same if the file was already recognized as containing 4-bit data packed into bytes. For a negative entry, change a mode 101 file back to mode 0 and divide the X size by 2 (X size must be even).

Field.name: SpaceGroup
Field.usage: Change the space group entry (0 stack, 1 volume, 401 multiple volumes)
Field.manpage: (Interactive ISPG) Change the space group entry, which should be 0 for an image stack, 1 for an image volume, and 401 for a stack with multiple volumes.

Field.name: VolumeStack
Field.usage: # of sections per volume to mark file as a volume stack, 0 to revert
Field.manpage: (Interactive VOLSTACK) Change the grid sampling in Z to equal the given number and the space group to 401 to mark the file as a volume stack with the given number of sections per volume. Enter 0 to revert from being a volume stack by setting the sample size equal to the total sections and the space group to 1. The pixel size will be preserved in these changes. Volume stacks will be loaded as multiple volumes in 3dmod(1) unless its \fB-T\fR option is entered.

Field.name: TitleToAdd
Field.usage: Add the given string as a new label (title)
Field.manpage: Add the given string as a new label (title) after all other labels in the file, unless the \fB-position\fR option is entered with a specific position. This option is not equivalent to the interactive LAB option. If there are already 10 labels, the last one will be replaced. Be sure to quote the whole string when running from the command line.

Field.name: PositionForTitle
Field.usage: Position that new title should be placed in, numbered from 1
Field.manpage: Position that new title should be placed in, numbered from 1. Note that a positive number is entered here, unlike the 0 or negative number entered with the interactive LAB option.

Field.name: RemoveTitles
Field.usage: List of existing titles to remove, numbered from 1
Field.manpage: List of existing titles to remove, numbered from 1; comma-separate ranges may be entered. This option can be used together with \fB-title\fR and \fB-position\fR; titles will be removed before one is added with \fB-title\fR.

Field.name: CopyFromImage
Field.usage: Image file with same X/Y size to copy scaling and origin values from
Field.manpage: Name of an image file with the same dimensions in X and Y from which to copy pixel size and origin information. Specifically, the sampling and cell size for X and Y will be copied from this file, and appropriately changed for a difference in Z size to give the same pixel size in Z. The origin and current tilt angles will also be copied, as well as the unused "start" coordinates. No other options can be entered with this option.

Field.usage: Print help output
